release_git_sha_note: The v1.0.0 tag points at this commit's own immediate child (a single small follow-up commit that records this exact SHA here, since a commit cannot self-referentially embed its own hash) -- both commits together are the release; the child adds nothing except this field.
runtime_source_note: pyproject.toml's version bump (0.1.0 -> 1.0.0, part of the v1.0.0 release-prep commit) matched build-containers.yml's own path filter and auto-triggered a real rebuild; both images were rebuilt from the exact tagged commit, promoted through two controlled Terraform applies (pipeline first, then API after gold/web was reverified), and a fresh production job run confirmed end to end -- runtime and release Git SHA are identical for this release, not merely a documented docs-only exception.
